@coderabbitai re the outside-diff comment on `CommandProvider.tsx` (81-83): closing on shallow completions is intentional. Path changes also pass `{ shallow: true }`, so skipping them would leave the menu open across real navigations (see f57ca44287). The actual fix is in `viewState.ts`: `setOpen` only calls `init()` when opening, so a never-opened menu stays unmounted on shallow updates. `CommandProvider.navigation.test.tsx` covers both cases.
